description: Turn any GitHub repo into an editable architecture diagram, every arrow cited to a file and line. Draw it, write it as code (Mermaid, D2, Structurizr in), ask any AI model or a local one, or let Claude Code edit it over MCP. Free, MIT, local-first, no account.
